Package com.saicone.types.util

Class WrappedObject<A,B>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedObject<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the base type of object.
B - the type of object to represent A.
Direct Known Subclasses:
WrappedCollection, WrappedIterator
public class WrappedObject<A,B> extends Object
Represents an Object type A that can be converted to type B.
